'''Mattiso Trodu''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[medic]] and a [[sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[224th Imperial Armored Division]] during the [[Mimban Campaign]]. During the war, he and [[Specialist]] [[Gillen Finders]] administered medical aid to [[Corporal]] [[Chakobi Sanwright]] after he received injuries from a concussive force.<ref name="TOG" />
